svg.title: Uniform control on the original nilpotent fibers
svg.desc: The original jet group has affine right translations in its raw coefficients. An independent intrinsic left-invariant vertical metric makes the group-arrow action unitary and supplies a vertical fundamental trace in the actual reduced C-star norm. A mixed-coordinate map F(u,v)=(v-2u,v), distinct from either group action, sends a bounding parallelogram of area 2 to the square [-1,1]^2 of area 4 with absolute determinant 2. The finite mixed-affine Jacobian argument gives a full scalar independent-translation bound. The general mixed characteristic cycle remains required. Proof: Propositions 13.30g-13.30i, equations 13.103o-13.103v. Human-source context: Connes 1986 Remark 7.16(a); Kellendonk-Schulz-Baldes 2004 Definition 3 and Example 7.

g.text: Uniform control on the original nilpotent fibers
Y = Vₖ → X = V₁; f = dim Hₖ > 0. Left isometries and right affine maps have different roles.
A. The intrinsic vertical metric gives a closed cycle
Section change: h ↦ c⁻¹h ; source frame: h ↦ R⁻¹hR ; group arrow: h ↦ c_g(x)h
Left translations and SO(n) conjugation are vertical isometries. No horizontal splitting is used.
Iₚ(ω) = ∫ₓ∫Yₓ ωₑ dνₓ ; τₚ(a₀,…,a_f) = Iₚ(a₀ dₚa₁ ⋯ dₚa_f)
|Iₚ(X₁dₚa₁⋯X_f dₚa_f)| ≤ C_(a₁,…,a_f) ∏_j ‖X_j‖Aᵧ ; actual reduced C*-norm.
B. Right composition is affine in all original jet coefficients
R_b(h) = h ∘ b = b + Σ_j h_j ∘ b (truncated at order k)
n = 1, k = 4: R(A,B,C)(a,b,c) = (A,B,C) + M(a,b,c)
Right-flow derivatives can grow quadratically in t. Their mixed Jacobian controls the integral.
C. A mixed-coordinate map gives the exact support bound
Φ₁(u,v) = (u,v−2u), Φ₂ = id. F(u,v) = (v−2u,v) selects one coordinate from each.

F, det DF = −2
Bounding region F⁻¹([-1,1]²): area 2.
Image square [-1,1]²: area 4.
Vertices: (0,−1), (−1,−1), (0,1), (1,1). Absolute Jacobian integral: 2 × 2 = 4.
D. The estimate is uniform in every independent affine parameter
M_(i,j) = sup |∂_j a_i| ; ℓ_(i,j) = length of the j-th interval enclosing supp a_i
∫ |d(a₁ ∘ Φ₁) ⋯ d(a_f ∘ Φ_f)| ≤ ∏_i (Σ_j M_(i,j) ℓ_(i,j))
A singular mixed-coordinate map contributes zero. The actual support lies inside its bounding region.
Proof: (13.103o)–(13.103v). This scalar bound and the vertical cycle do not supply the mixed characteristic cycle.
Human sources: Connes (1986), Remark 7.16(a); Kellendonk–Schulz-Baldes (2004), Definition 3, Example 7.
